answer_1.quote: We form relation description generation as a conditional text generation task: given two entities, generating a sentence describing the relationship between them with the initial DEER.
answer_1.outputs: Sentences (relation descriptions) that describe the relationship between a pair of entities

answer_2.quote: we apply several automatic metrics, including BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: we ask three human annotators (graduate students doing research on computational linguistics) to assign a graded value (1-5) for each relation description ... we also ask three human annotators to evaluate the output relation descriptions with the same rating scale
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each relation description on a 1‑5 scale according to explicitness, significance and correctness (as defined in the annotation guidelines).
